paths.name: Path of Incineration
paths.description: A mastery path focused on immediate damage

ability.name: Searing Vitality
ability.description: Sear will now heal you for 67% of the damage that it deals.

ability.name: Funnel Power
ability.description: You become a living conduit for the power of the Red Wind of Magic, causing all of your directly damaging magical attacks to deal an additional 150 Corporeal damage to your target, but you will also suffer 75 damage for each one.  Use this ability again to turn it off.

ability.name: Draining Burn
ability.description: Burning Iron will now deal 403 damage, and you will regain 50 action points when it hits.

ability.name: Nova
ability.note:
Builds 40 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: A powerful spell which makes your target spontaneously combust, dealing 478 Elemental damage to them.

ability.name: Burn Through
ability.description: Fireball and Pyroclastic Surge are now virtually undefendable.

ability.name: Fireball Barrage
ability.note:
Builds 15 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: You assault your target with a constant stream of fireballs, striking them up to 3 times over 3 seconds.  Each blast deals 483 Elemental damage to your target, and 242 Elemental damage to all other enemies within 20 feet of them.  This effect will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points.

ability.name: The Burning Head
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to your target, and 1800 to all other enemies within 20 feet of them.  All enemies hit by this effect will lose 600 points of Morale.

coreAbilities.name: Fireball
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: You conjure up a fiery missile which slams into your target, dealing 733 Elemental damage.

coreAbilities.name: Sear
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 25 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: Causes a pillar of scalding gas to erupt from the ground, dealing 403 Elemental damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Flames of Rhuin
coreAbilities.description: An Enchantment which infuses your groupmates within 100 feet of you with the spirit of fire for 1 hour, giving them a 25% chance to deal an additional 225 Elemental damage any time they attack a target.

coreAbilities.name: Pyroclastic Surge
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: A fountain of molten lava envelops your target, dealing 436 Corporeal damage.  If they are Hexed, then they will also be inflicted with a disorienting Hex for 3 seconds, causing all of their actions to take an additional 50% longer to build up.

coreAbilities.name: Burning Iron
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: Your target's weapons become red hot, dealing 253 Corporeal damage to them and causing them to lose 50 Action Points.

paths.name: Path of Immolation
paths.description: A mastery path focused on longer-duration effects

ability.name: Fuel To The Fire
ability.description: Boiling Blood's Willpower debuff is increased to 350 for 5 seconds and will deal 767 Corporeal damage at the end of the debuff duration.

ability.name: Playing With Fire
ability.description: A Hex which surrounds the target with hungry flames, causing all healing used on them for the next 10 seconds to become 50% less effective.  Each time someone attempts to use a direct heal on them, the flames will lash out, and healer will suffer 498 Elemental damage.

ability.name: Ignition
ability.description: The cost of Ignite is reduced by 20 and it will reduce the enemy's Corporeal resistance by 360 for 9 seconds.

ability.name: Withering Heat
ability.note:
Builds 15 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: You turn the air around your enemy into a grasping storm of burning flames for up to 6 seconds, dealing up to 1772 Corporeal damage and snaring them, reducing their run speed by 40%.  This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

ability.name: Smoldering Embers
ability.description: When Ignite, Boiling Blood, and Slow Boil end or are removed, there is a 25% chance that they will re-kindle, reapplying themselves to the target once again.  Be cautious, though, for you will build Combustion and have a chance to cause an Explosion each time that they are reapplied!

ability.name: Stop, Drop, And Roll
ability.note:
Target must be Ignited
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: You grasp the power of your Ignite hex and cause it to explode with concussive force, dealing 328 Elemental damage to your target and knocking them down for 2 seconds, but extinguishing your Ignite.

ability.name: Wall of Fire
ability.description: A wall of fire shoots outward from you toward your target, remaining on the ground for 8 seconds. It deals 300 damage per second to all enemies in a line up to 65 feet away from you.

coreAbilities.name: Ignite
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 5 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: A Hex which causes your target to burst into flames, dealing 606 Elemental damage to them over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Boiling Blood
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 5 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: Reduces your target's Willpower by 150 for 10 seconds.  When the effect ends, the victim will suffer 514 Corporeal damage.

coreAbilities.name: Detonate
coreAbilities.note:
Target must be Hexed
Builds 25 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: You reach through the power of a Hex on the target to instantly deal 220 Elemental damage to them, and an additional 336 Elemental damage over 9 seconds to them and all other enemies within 20 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Flame Shield
coreAbilities.description: All groupmates within 100 feet are Enchanted with a protective shield of flickering flames for 1 hour, giving them a 25% chance to deal 187 Elemental damage back against the attacker when they are struck by a melee attack.

coreAbilities.name: Slow Boil
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: For the next 5 seconds, the target is inflicted with a Hex which raises their temperature to a delirious fever, causing them to lose 6 Action Points every 1 seconds.  When this effect ends, they will suffer 314 Corporeal damage as the fever peaks.

paths.name: Path of Conflagration
paths.description: A mastery path focused on wide-area effects

ability.name: Explosive Force
ability.description: Any time that your Combustion causes an Explosion, the blast will also deal 50% of the damage to all enemies within 25 feet of you.

ability.name: Annihilate
ability.note:
Builds 15 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: You concentrate on your magical powers for up to 3 seconds, opening your body to serve as a vessel for the raw power of the Red Wind.  The unleashed power will deal 217 Corporeal damage each second to all enemies within 25 feet. This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

ability.name: Fiery Reserves
ability.description: Reduces the cooldown times of Flame Breath and Rain Of Fire by 10 seconds.

ability.name: Spreading Flames
ability.note:
Target must be Hexed
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: Deals 605 Elemental damage to your target over 15 seconds.  Each time that this effect damages them, the flames will spread, causing 153 Elemental damage over 3 seconds to all other enemies within 20 feet of them.

ability.name: Wildfire
ability.description: When an enemy is hit by any Conflagration ability, there is a 25% chance that they will become covered in flames, receiving 400 Elemental damage over  5 seconds.

ability.name: Backdraft
ability.note:
Builds 10 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
ability.description: Aqshy, the Wind of Fire, bursts forth explosively around you, dealing 995 Corporeal damage over 15 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet.  The force of the blast will send enemy players flying away from you, while monsters will be knocked down.

ability.name: Conflagration of Doom
ability.description: A spot that you select bursts into flames for 8 seconds, dealing 300 damage each second to all enemies within 20 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Scorched Earth
coreAbilities.note:
Costs 20 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: You send a blast of heat into the ground around you, dealing 231 Corporeal damage to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Fiery Blast
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 20 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: You fling a massive ball of fire, dealing 516 Elemental damage to your target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them.

coreAbilities.name: Flame Breath
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 20 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: You momentarily turn your very breath into a rolling burst of flames, dealing 708 Elemental damage over 9 seconds to all enemies in a cone in front of you, up to 40 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Rain of Fire
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 15 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: You call down a shower of flames from the Winds Of Magic that rains down for the next 9 seconds, falling upon a spot you select and repeatedly dealing 258 Elemental damage to all enemies within 20 feet of that spot. If there are multiple Rain of Fires in the same area only the highest level one will deal damage.

coreAbilities.name: Choking Smoke
coreAbilities.note:
Builds 20 Combustion
Has a chance to cause an Explosion!
coreAbilities.description: Turn the air into unbreathable smoke and ash, dealing 314 Corporeal damage to your target.  The target and all other enemies within 20 feet become silenced for 3 seconds, making them unable to use magic.

coreAbilities.name: Enhance War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted buff. Increases damage done by that siege engine by 2% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hex War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Increases the cooldown times of that siege engine by 50% for 10 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Abate War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Decreases damage done by that siege engine to 98% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Meltdown
coreAbilities.description:
You expel all of your build-up Combustion in a fiery blast, dealing damage to your target based on the amount of Combustion that was consumed.
   1 - 10 Combustion:  75 damage.
   11 - 30 Combustion:  150 damage.
   31 - 70 Combustion:  300 damage.
   71 - 90 Combustion:  600 damage.
   91 - 100 Combustion:  750 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Shield of Aqshy
coreAbilities.description: An Enchantment which calls upon the power of the Red Wind to increase your armor by 594 for 10 seconds, and makes it 50% less likely that you will be set back while building up abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Smoke Screen
coreAbilities.description: You Detaunt your target by surrounding them with thick smoke, making them hate you less and causing them to deal only 50% damage to you for 15 seconds.  You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Mage Bolt
coreAbilities.description: A focused blast that deals 600 damage and knocks the targeted player away. Monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Emperor's Ward
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will become protected by a magical barrier for up to 10 seconds, which will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Cauterize
coreAbilities.note: You must be Cursed, Hexed, or Ailing
coreAbilities.description: You cause an open wound to sear itself shut, removing one Hex, Curse, or Ailment from yourself.

coreAbilities.name: Fire Cage
coreAbilities.description: Up to 4 enemies within 25 feet are Rooted as they become trapped within a cage of searing flames, making them unable to move for 5 seconds.  Rooted targets have a 50% chance to break free when they suffer damage.

coreAbilities.name: Siphon Power
coreAbilities.description: You drain power from your target, stealing up to 200 action points from your target and giving them to you. Your target's Intelligence will also be reduced by 150 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Devour Energy
coreAbilities.description: Whenever one of your spells hits an enemy, you have a 25% chance to regain 30 Action Points. This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Lingering Fires
coreAbilities.description: Pyroclastic Surge and Scorched Earth gain a 25% chance to cause an additional 470 Elemental damage over 5 seconds to each target hit.

coreAbilities.name: Endless Knowledge
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Intelligence by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Misdirection
coreAbilities.description: You gain a strong counter aura for the next 10 seconds that will reduce half of any incoming Magic damage and redirect half of any direct damage back to the caster.

coreAbilities.name: Unwavering Faith
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Spirit resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: Fueled From Within
coreAbilities.description: Flames Of Rhuin will now deal 300 damage, and Flame Shield will now deal 300 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Sigmar's Favor
coreAbilities.description: Any time that you are healed by a direct heal, there is a 25% chance that you will regain an additional 135 hit points as well.

coreAbilities.name: Scintillating Energy
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1200 damage to your target and staggers them for 9 seconds, preventing all actions until they take damage.

coreAbilities.name: Sleight of Hand
coreAbilities.description: Enemy monsters will hate you 50% less than normal.

coreAbilities.name: Power From The Ashes
coreAbilities.description: Meltdown will now restore your action points, returning an amount equal to the Combustion which was expended.

coreAbilities.name: Magic Dart
coreAbilities.description: Deals 600 damage to your target immediately, and another 1206 damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Close Quarters
coreAbilities.description: Your cast times are reduced to 50% when you are within 20 feet of your target.

coreAbilities.name: Burnout
coreAbilities.description: You call upon the Winds Of Magic to grant you power, instantly regaining 160 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Flashfire
coreAbilities.description:
Any time an enemy disrupts one of your spells, your next spell within the next 10 seconds which would normally have a buildup time will cast instantly instead.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 6 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Ruin And Destruction
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Fan The Flames
coreAbilities.description: Increases the radii of Rain Of Fire and Detonate by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Fires
coreAbilities.description: Reduces the cooldown times of Smoke Screen and Fire Cage by 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Heart of Fire
coreAbilities.description: Removes all Hexes and Curses from you.  You regain 485 health over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Embrace The Flames
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy with a direct damage ability, you will gain 75 points of Morale. This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Crown of Fire
coreAbilities.description: Flames of Rhuin now has a 40% chance to trigger.

coreAbilities.name: Unleash the Winds
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1800 damage to all enemies within 25 feet, and for the next 10 seconds your cast times are reduced by 50%, cost 25% less Action Points and you cannot be set back during this time.
